visual_goal: Show a lease return flowing from the contract feed to a released car, with every selling channel passing through the sale-right register before a binding deal.
prompt: A left-to-right flow illustration. Far left: a calendar box labeled 'Return pipeline'. One arrow from it to a clipboard-and-car box labeled 'Digital return'. One arrow from 'Digital return' to a magnifier box labeled 'Condition and valuation'. One arrow from 'Condition and valuation' to a central padlock box, drawn larger and in orange, labeled 'Sale-right register'. From 'Sale-right register' two arrows fan out, each labeled 'lease': one up-right to a box showing a plain laptop screen with a small car picture, labeled 'Tradefloor listing', and one down-right to a gavel box labeled 'Auction partner'. One arrow from 'Tradefloor listing' and one arrow from 'Auction partner' both converge into a handshake document box labeled 'Trade deal'. One final arrow from 'Trade deal' to a generic unbranded car leaving an open gate labeled 'Release'. Icons carry no signs and no writing; these nine labels plus the two 'lease' arrow labels are the only words in the image.
alt: A return moves from the return pipeline through the digital return and condition and valuation to the sale-right register, which leases the car to either the Tradefloor listing or the auction partner; both lead into one trade deal and then release.

visual_goal: Show the right-to-sell states, including Expired as its own state that can still receive a late auction result.
prompt: A simple state map of five rounded tiles. Left: blue 'Unoffered'. Center: teal 'Leased' with a small key icon. Right: green 'Accepted'. Far right: dark green 'Released'. Below 'Leased': orange 'Expired' with a small hourglass icon. Exactly seven arrows: one from 'Unoffered' to 'Leased' labeled 'grant'; one from 'Leased' to 'Accepted' labeled 'current token'; one curved arrow from 'Leased' back to 'Unoffered' labeled 'no sale'; one from 'Leased' down to 'Expired' labeled 'time passes'; one from 'Expired' back to 'Unoffered'; one from 'Expired' up-right to 'Accepted' labeled 'late result'; one from 'Accepted' to 'Released' labeled 'paid'. These eleven labels are the only words in the image.
alt: State map: Unoffered becomes Leased on a grant; Leased becomes Accepted with the current token, returns to Unoffered on no sale, or becomes Expired; Expired can return to Unoffered or take a late result into Accepted; Accepted becomes Released when paid.

visual_goal: Show the auction hand-off as a lease granted, a lot created with the lease id, and a hammer result returned through the deal service, plus daily reconciliation.
prompt: A left-to-right swimlane illustration with five vertical lanes, each headed by a simple icon and a label: a desk with a monitor labeled 'Lessor desk', a padlock labeled 'Sale-right register', a plug connector labeled 'Auction adapter', a gavel labeled 'Auction partner', and a handshake document labeled 'Trade deal'. Horizontal arrows from top to bottom: an arrow from 'Lessor desk' to 'Sale-right register' labeled 'request lease'; an arrow from 'Sale-right register' to 'Auction adapter' labeled 'token'; an arrow from 'Auction adapter' to 'Auction partner' labeled 'create lot'; a return arrow from 'Auction partner' to 'Auction adapter' labeled 'hammer price'; an arrow from 'Auction adapter' to 'Trade deal' labeled 'binding result'. At the bottom, a dashed orange arrow from 'Auction adapter' to 'Auction partner' with a small circular-arrows icon, labeled 'daily reconciliation'. These eleven labels are the only words in the image.
alt: Swimlanes for lessor desk, sale-right register, auction adapter, auction partner and trade deal: the desk requests a lease, the register passes a token to the adapter, the adapter creates a lot, the partner returns the hammer price, the adapter posts a binding result to the trade deal, and a daily reconciliation runs between adapter and partner.
